refusal.invalid_args.what: The arguments do not match the tool's input schema.
refusal.invalid_args: Correct the field named in detail to the shape the tool's schema gives, then call again.
refusal.unknown_target.what: Nothing in the model matches the target.
refusal.unknown_target: Look the elements up first (query or find tools) and pass their references as cat:id.
refusal.snapshots_off.what: Screenshots are turned off for the assistant.
refusal.snapshots_off: Ask the person to enable screenshots in the AI settings, or describe the model with read tools instead.
refusal.snapshot_unavailable.what: The view could not be captured just now.
refusal.snapshot_unavailable: Try again in a moment, or use read tools to describe the model.
refusal.not_allowed_in_mode.what: This tool is not allowed in the current mode of the session.
refusal.not_allowed_in_mode: Use a read tool, or ask the person to switch the assistant to a mode that allows changes.
refusal.needs_confirmation.what: The person requires confirmation of this change.
refusal.needs_confirmation: The change waits on the card; wait for the person's Apply and check the plan status.
refusal.busy.what: The editor is busy with another request.
refusal.plan_stale.what: The model changed after the plan was made.
refusal.plan_stale: Read the current state again and rebuild the plan on it.
refusal.plan_conflict.what: The plan conflicts with the current model or with the card the person sees.
refusal.plan_conflict: Check the plan status, resolve the named difference and propose again.
refusal.mass_delete_blocked: Large deletions need the person: the plan waits on the card for their confirmation.
refusal.since_expired.what: The change history no longer reaches back to {since}.
refusal.since_expired: Run the checks without since to get the full list.
refusal.limit_exceeded.what: The request is over a limit of the session.
refusal.limit_exceeded: Split the request into smaller parts and call again.
refusal.cancelled: Stop here; continue only when the person asks again.
refusal.internal.what: The tool failed inside the editor.
refusal.internal: Try a different approach; if it repeats, tell the person what you were doing.
refusal.draft_invalid.what: The family draft does not pass validation.
refusal.draft_invalid: Fix the issues listed in detail and submit the draft again.
refusal.text_too_large.what: The text is over the size limit of the tool.
refusal.text_too_large: Shorten the text or split it into parts, then call again.
refusal.unknown_family.what: No family with that name exists in the project.
refusal.unknown_family: List the families first and pass an existing name.
refusal.repair_stopped.what: Automatic repair stopped without a valid result.
refusal.repair_stopped: Show the person the remaining issues and ask how to continue.
refusal.name_taken.what: The name is already used in the project.
refusal.name_taken: Choose a different name, or edit the existing item instead.
refusal.no_effect.what: The call is valid but changes nothing.
refusal.no_effect: Check what was left out (detail) and change the target or the values.
refusal.unknown_tool: Call a tool from the list you were given; load its tool group first if needed.
